capabilities: Encrypt a selected file with a password
Follow the rclone-crypt format for encrypted output
disambiguation: It does not encrypt the whole vault or lock notes in place; it creates separate encrypted copies of files you pick.
extras: README warns the password is never stored, so forgotten passwords cannot be recovered; whether rclone itself is required to decrypt files is not explained.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to produce encrypted versions of individual files, so sensitive notes stay readable in the vault.

relations.evidence: The plugin follows the rclone-crypt format.

summary: Generates password-encrypted copies of vault files following the rclone-crypt encryption format.
